affected_system: drinking-water distribution, sewer collection, pumping, and treatment assets
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load
pair weather, condition, hydraulic, and process-load forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Assets, inspections, breaks, overflows, pressure, flow, quality, work, and complaints remain distinct.
Hydraulic, process, condition, and consequence models receive utility engineering review.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load.

constraints.description: The water and wastewater infrastructure forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: water and wastewater utility asset director
decision_question: What probabilistic flow, quality, break, overflow, and treatment-load range should operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The water and wastewater infrastructure forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: weather, condition, hydraulic, and process-load forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: service demand and failure load above operable capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: service demand and failure load above operable capacity
distributional gap in service demand and failure load above operable capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present modeled breaks, quality events, or overflows as observed incidents.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for water and wastewater demand, failure, and treatment load passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast utility demand, failures, and treatment load
transportability_risks: Network age, materials, soils, climate, regulation, treatment, hydraulics, and costs differ.
Published incidents and complaints can omit failures or lack asset-level linkage.
